tweets.text:
one thing i find interesting about Grass is the growing importance of data infrastructure as AI scales

AI labs need massive amounts of data, but accessing public web data is becoming increasingly difficult

Grass uses a distributed network of internet connections to help collect that data and make it available to AI companies

i believe access to high-quality data will become an increasingly important competitive advantage in AI, which makes this an interesting area to follow
